notes.7: Most candidates failed to read this question carefully and chose option C, giving the spring’s length rather than its extension.
notes.12: This question on pressure was generally well answered, although many candidates chose B, presumably believing that the heels were shown from the side, and not as stated in the question.
notes.16: Only the very strongest candidates answered this question correctly. The concept of change of state happening at constant temperature was unfamiliar to most candidates.
notes.18: All options were equally popular on this question on transfer of thermal energy suggesting a lack of knowledge of this topic.
notes.23: A large proportion of candidates did not believe that a ray of light could pass through a rectangular glass block without being deviated, and therefore chose diagram B as the incorrect one.
notes.29: Most candidates, including many of the more able, thought that moving the lamp to the left side of the resistor would increase the current in it.
